finalText:
**The build passes now.** One real error was hiding in there:

```
ERROR EBUILD01 link-failed: src/core/settings.js — ReferenceError: retries is not defined
```

`resolveConfig` in `src/core/settings.js` read a bare `retries` that was never declared. It now reads `env.retries` and falls back to a new `DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES` of 3, which is what the comment above it asked for.

Build finished, exit 0. The 3 warnings are still there and none of them stop the build:

| Code | Where |
| --- | --- |
| W1042 deprecated `crypto.createCipher` | `src/legacy/adapter.js` |
| W2213 unused export `formatLegacyDate` | `src/utils/format.js` |
| W3307 circular import | `src/core/graph.js` ↔ `src/state/tracker.js` |

Those three files don't exist in `src` yet, so the warnings are cosmetic for now. Happy to chase them if you want a truly silent log.
